result_text:
The per-rep purchase order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. Reps with none in the period are still listed with 0, and the highest-count-first ordering is unchanged.

The fix is in `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. I added `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` to the count subquery, the same filter the other purchase-order queries use, and updated the Javadoc to say "non-cancelled".

I ran the tests matching `*SalesRep*` and `*PurchaseOrder*` and they pass. I didn't add a test for your Anna/Bob example, and I didn't check whether an existing test already covers cancelled purchase orders in this report.
